newsitem.title: SPAIN: Banco Popular says 9-mth net profit up 6.2 pct. [CORRECTED 8:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Banco Popular says 9-mth net profit up 6.2 pct. [CORRECTED 8:44 GMT]

text.p: Results for first nine months in billions of pesetas, unless stated:

NOTE- Banco Popular Espanol said the banking sector had been negatively affected by continuing interest rate falls in the third quarter which were squeezing margins. Operating costs fell 0.2 percent in the third quarter for a 4.9 percent rise in the first nine months of 1996. The relative level of doubtful debts fell from 2.41 percent to 2.29 percent (corrects from "...to 2.41 percent from 2.29 percent"...) in the last 12 months and the level of debt coverage rose to 86.4 percent from 74.8 percent in the same period, not counting mortgage coverage on some bad debtors.
